annotation.bound_parties_text: The Act binds the State and local governments, project implementers of robotlands, persons operating certified outdoor mobile robots (insurance duty), and certification institutions.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: A person who operates an outdoor mobile robot that has obtained safety certification shall purchase an insurance policy or enter into a mutual aid agreement
annotation.dates_quote: This Act shall enter into force six months after the date of its promulgation.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: The purpose of this Act is to contribute to the quality of life of citizens and the national economy by establishing and promoting policies on the sustainable development of the intelligent robot industry
